description: A list of such objects defines to which queue instance(s) a job has been scheduled.
For sequential jobs / tasks of an array job there is a single object of JG_Type.
In case of tightly integrated parallel jobs there is an object per queue instance.
The first object defines where the master task of the job is running.

attributes.name: qname
description: The queue instance name.

attributes.name: qversion
description: The qinstance's version. Is used to detect when a qinstance was changed during scheduling.

attributes.name: qhostname
description: The qualified host name of the queue instance.
It is redundand (cached) information also contained in qname.

attributes.name: slots
description: The amount of slots the job occupies in the queue instance.
Always 1 for sequential jobs / tasks of array jobs, >= 1 for parallel jobs

attributes.name: queue
description: The queue instance definition with information required in sge_execd,
like limits, the tmp directory, ...

attributes.name: tag_slave_job
description: Tag used in the job delivery protocol, is set when a slave host acknowledged receipt of the start order.

attributes.name: ticket
description: Total amount of tickets assigned to slots.

attributes.name: oticket
description: Override tickets assigned to slots.

attributes.name: fticket
description: Functional tickets assigned to slots.

attributes.name: sticket
description: Sharetree tickets assigned to slots.

attributes.name: jcoticket
description: Job class override tickets.

attributes.name: jcfticket
description: Job class functional tickets.

attributes.name: processors
description: Processor set the job is supposed to run on (Solaris only?)

attributes.name: binding_to_use
description: One entry for sequential jobs or multiple entries for PE jobs in case of host/task specific binding

attributes.name: granted_rsmaps
description: List of RSMAP IDs granted to this job / specific tasks of a parallel job,
which are running on the specific queue instance / host described by this object.
